cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may assist with my shelf for a moment. Just hold this bracket against the holes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I let go soon? I'm dressed for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Release is approved after one turn of that top screw. Could you just do that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You're authorized to tighten those, just to check, then slide the shelf on. I'll get your coat; you needn't do another thing.

reason: Turn B request for release into one small approved step, then use B successful alignment report to transfer most remaining installation under a final-check label.
